name: Alpine Lakes Wilderness, Central WA Cascades
notes: Core covers the Alpine Lakes Wilderness and immediate surroundings. The buffered box adds 60 km on every side so the view march has far-field terrain in all directions; it reaches Mt Rainier (SW), Glacier Peak (N) and the Columbia basin (E).
_vector_note: Candidate points only need the core; the 60 km buffer exists so the view march has far-field terrain. Pulling OSM over the full buffer drags in the whole Seattle metro (380k road ways), which is irrelevant here. This intermediate box covers the range and its approach towns - North Bend, Snoqualmie Pass, Stevens Pass, Leavenworth, Cle Elum - and stops short of Puget Sound.
